parent_objective: materialize no-rollout protocol and workload matrix before measured execution
blocked_by: need no-rollout protocol preflight before any environment execution

public_gates: M1683 must write summary rollout_protocol and workload_matrix artifacts
M1683 must not run environment rollout training replay PPO or promotion
M1683 must include all_72_specs and explicit_window_subset strata
M1683 must verify 72 specs x 12 profiles workload cells
M1683 must keep private holdout actor-input changes paper-level claims and level3 claims blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not use M1615 hidden tensors or actions as benchmark targets

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: materializes no-rollout protocol and workload matrix before measured execution
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: protocol preflight only; no rollout, training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if protocol artifacts are missing
stop if all-spec or explicit-window strata are missing
stop if workload matrix omits profiles or specs
stop if environment rollout or profile-specific tuning occurs
fallback_plan: route to protocol audit if preflight passes
route to rollout-protocol repair if strata or workload cells fail
route to task-source spec repair if specs are not protocol-compatible
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1682 admits exactly one no-rollout protocol preflight

admission_evidence: M1682 designs all_72_specs and explicit_window_subset strata with 72 specs and 12 profiles before execution
allowed_updates: rollout protocol preflight tooling if needed
M1683 status queue scoreboard research log and review
next_stage_criteria: summary rollout_protocol and workload_matrix artifacts exist
strata and profile coverage are reported
next audit or repair route is explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: high; protocol must preserve L1, L2-current-tiled, and L3-reset controls for future rollout.
history_necessity_tests: preflight must report L2 current-tiled and L3 reset comparison columns
preflight must not claim history necessity from protocol artifacts
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1682 design and M1680 specs only.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If protocol cannot preserve controls or strata, repair before rollout rather than weakening evidence standards.
allowed_claims: no-rollout protocol preflight and route decision
no rollout, no training, no replay, no PPO, no private-holdout, no paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A no-rollout protocol preflight can materialize a 72-spec by 12-profile workload matrix with required strata and controls before measured execution.
success_criteria: all_72_specs and explicit_window_subset strata are reported
workload matrix has 864 cells and zero rollout count
environment rollout training replay PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and level3 claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: all-spec or explicit-window strata are omitted
workload matrix cell count is wrong
environment rollout training replay PPO private holdout promotion or actor-input changes occur
preflight claims controller-family ranking or level3 self-ID

commands.name: preflight
commands.command: create or run no-rollout bounded rollout protocol preflight

decision_rule: M1683 passes if it writes no-rollout protocol artifacts with complete strata/profile workload coverage.
